items.exampleEn: My son goes to an elementary school near our home.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子讀我們家附近的小學。

items.exampleEn: This is an ideal place for a picnic.
The sum of two and three is five.

items.sentenceEn: Please write one sentence with a pen.

items.audioEn: My suggestion is to study math every day.
items.audioZh: 我的建議是每天都讀數學。

items.sentenceEn: This is an ideal job for me.
items.sentenceZh: 這對我來說是理想的工作。

items.sentenceEn: My sister teaches at an elementary school.

items.stemEn: The ____ of four and six is ten.
Thank you for your ____. It is a good idea.
items.stemZh: 謝謝你的建議，這是個好主意。

items.passageEn: Lucy teaches math at an elementary school. Her students are young, so she makes math fun. She tells them a short story with numbers in it, and they find the sum. Then each student writes one sentence about it with a pen. The other teachers say it is an ideal way to learn.
items.passageZh: Lucy 在小學教數學。她的學生年紀小，所以她把數學變得很好玩。她會講一個有數字的小故事，讓學生算出總和，然後每個學生用筆寫一個關於這個故事的句子。其他老師都說這是理想的學習方式。

rubricZh: ideal 可放在名詞前（例如 an ideal place；母音開頭用 an），也可放在 be 動詞後（例如 This place is ideal.）
寫 This is the ideal place. 也正確
道謝可寫，例如 Thank you for…、Thanks for… 等
suggestion 單數、複數都正確（例如 your suggestion、your suggestions）
